dex.entry: A small, crystalline geode-crab whose outer shell is a natural geode split down the middle, exposing a cavity glittering with frost-crystal druzy. It scuttles along glacier crevasse walls and eats mineral-rich ice. Its shell grows a new layer of crystals each winter. A geode as a crab-shell is visua

art.silhouette: Squat crab-like form; body is literally a split geode half — rough dark mineral exterior with a spectacular glittering interior visible from above; six short spiky legs; two crystal-tipped pincer claws; unique silhouette readable at 32px as a lumpy oval with jutting points.

art.direction: A geode as a crab-shell is visually unlike anything else — the glittering interior is a treasure chest on legs.
